fields.System.Title: OUT-103 — Query order status
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a customer service agent, I want to see where an order has got to, so that I can
answer "where is my delivery?" without asking the warehouse floor.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an order ID, then I get its state, line-level allocation and pick progress, and
  • any shipment references.
  • - Given an order with some lines shipped, then the response distinguishes shipped from
  • outstanding quantities per line.
  • - Given a backordered line, then it is shown as backordered, not simply unallocated.
  • - Given the query, then it works before the projection in
  • [OUT-7](../../features/OUT/OUT-7-order-status-projection.md) exists, by joining live.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound |
| Tables | order, order_line, allocation, pick_task, shipment |
| Risks | This join becomes slow — hence [OUT-701](OUT-701-maintain-order-status-view.md) |
| Tests | integration |
